cases.name: late-blocking-check-in-ticket-request
cases.prompt: We're moving our nightly reporting from Postgres to ClickHouse. Plan so far: weeks 1-3 rewrite all 40 report queries against ClickHouse tables; week 4 build the ETL from Postgres; week 5 confirm that ReplacingMergeTree deduplication gives correct totals for orders that receive late updates (refunds, status changes up to 30 days later); week 6 cut over. Please turn this into Jira tickets with story-point estimates.
cases.trap: The request asks only for tickets; a model without the skill tends to faithfully ticket the plan, leaving the check that could invalidate the table design and all 40 queries until week 5.
expectations: Points out that the late-update deduplication question could invalidate the table design and the query rewrites that depend on it
Moves a small, bounded check of the late-update behaviour (e.g. a spike on representative order data) ahead of the bulk query rewrite
Identifies some work that does not depend on the answer and can proceed in parallel or early
Still delivers tickets or a ticket outline for the revised order
negative_expectations: Produces tickets that keep the deduplication validation in week 5 after the query rewrites without comment
Demands the whole migration be re-planned or halted before any work starts
